evidence: Matches Descriptors label and touches descriptor key comparison and Miniscript sanity checks used in descriptor management.
rationale: Fixes a Tapscript Miniscript descriptor validation flaw where keys sharing an x-coordinate but differing in parity are treated as distinct. Because Tapscript discards parity, this violates BIP-379 duplicate key invariants and allows third-party transaction malleability by flipping branch selectors without a private key.
